description.value: Outdoor Lovers Bed & Breakfast is a family-run B&B in Port Alberni overlooking the historic Alberni Inlet, operated by Bill and Milly since 2018 and positioned midway on the Highway 4 corridor between Nanaimo and Tofino. The property offers three distinct rooms with full breakfast (including vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, and lactose-free options), a front balcony with inlet views, and a poolside pergola with koi pond. It sits at the gateway to Stamp River Provincial Park, Cathedral Grove, and day-trip access to Pacific Rim National Park, making it a natural base for cyclists touring Vancouver Island's west coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and is the primary evidence source. The site confirms an active, owner-operated B&B in Port Alberni run by Bill and Milly, with rooms, full breakfast, and High-speed WiFi listed as a room feature on the /our-rooms/ subpage. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying area, e-bike charging, tools, pump, or bike wash is found anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null. A postal code discrepancy exists: OSM lists V9Y 1Z6 while the website contact page shows V9Y 8C8; the website value is preferred.
concerns: Postal code mismatch: OSM lists V9Y 1Z6 but website contact page shows V9Y 8C8. Website value used as primary.
Website lists two phone numbers (778-814-7829 and 778-321-7829); OSM only captures the first. Both should be noted for the listing.
No mention of bike storage, bike-specific services, or cycling amenities anywhere on the website despite the outdoor/adventure positioning.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate, actively operated B&B well-suited to touring cyclists exploring Vancouver Island, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) is confirmed anywhere on the website. Direct outreach to Bill or Milly is needed to verify bike storage arrangements before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: The hosts (Bill and Milly) are reachable at merlynent@proton.me or 778-814-7829. A brief inquiry about bike storage arrangements would likely resolve the required criteria. The B&B holds BC STR Registration H102063035 and City of Port Alberni 2025 Business Licence 02103472, confirming it is a legitimately registered short-term rental.
